chapter: Paris 1951-70 and return to New York
title: Forming the orchestra at the Cigale in Pigalle
summary: He formed an orchestra at a Pigalle club called La Cigale and stayed about ten years, working summers at a large casino.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So, all right, I giged around various places. Got a chance to form an orchestra at a place called "Cégale" (PHONETIC). Cégale means the grasshopper and the ant. Cégale is the grasshopper. (Inaudible).

I know Pigalle, I know Chez (PHONETIC) Pigalle. So I made the band (inaudible). So I stayed there for about ten years. Ten years. In fact, back in the summertime I'd go (inaudible) which is a beautiful casino (inaudible). That's one of the biggest casinos in the world.
